event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Albert Vadell (coach of ESP 210172) attended the hearing as an observer.
Race Committee represented by Marko Misura.
On request of ESP 210172 race committee presented a video from the pin end.
facts: Race 10 ILCA 7 men gold fleet was started with black flag as preparatory signal.
ESP 210172 was find in the triangle formed by both ends of the starting line and mark no. 1
Race committee scored ESP 210172 BFD in race no. 10
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
